Park Effect: Which Ballparks Helped the Most?

Comparing home-run carry across MLB stadiums in 2025

The same swing does not travel the same way in every ballpark. A home run in one stadium can be a warning-track out in another, even when the exit velocity and launch angle look nearly identical.

This page uses Statcast home-run data to compare how much a ballpark seems to boost or suppress home-run carry. Instead of treating every home run as identical, we compare each stadium’s median home-run distance to the season-wide median and ask: which parks were most generous to hitters in 2025?

What this plot is showing

This chart compares each stadium’s median home-run distance against the overall 2025 median. Positive values indicate a park where home runs tended to carry farther than the league average; negative values suggest a tougher environment for hitters.

The most hitter-friendly ballparks

These are the stadiums where the median home run traveled furthest above the league norm.
